title: 499 & Under Fargo Rated 8-Ball Bar Box Shootout
photo_alt: Flyer: Nov 7th 499 and under Fargo rated 8 ball bar box shootout at Two Stooges. First 64 players, 4/3 race, alt break, double elimination, $40 entry fee, money added. Doors 10 AM, check-in closes 11 AM, starts 11:30 AM. Call or text Nick Johnson 612-449-9987.
description: An 8-ball bar box shootout for players rated 499 and under on FargoRate. Only the first 64 players who sign up get in, so call or text early to grab your spot.
notes: Players must have 150 robustness in FargoRate, or entry is at the tournament director's discretion.
